description: Fraunhofer ISI and collaborating authors publish an Excel annex of modelling results for future European hydrogen infrastructure. Zenodo supplies the workbook free under CC BY 4.0. It contains detailed spatial energy balances, distributed hydrogen-demand estimates and aggregated energy- and process-emission results from the describing study. These tables can benchmark hydrogen transport, generation and demand scenarios in cross-sector energy simulations. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this results annex. Coverage is the paper’s modelled European energy system, with precise regional units, scenario years and workbook field definitions requiring inspection. A limitation is that results are projections governed by model assumptions, not observed demand or approved pipeline plans. A separate article provides the argument; the Zenodo workbook is the reusable resource. No workbook was downloaded, model run or emissions balance recalculated.
name: Annex to the paper 'Hydrogen infrastructure in the future CO2-neutral European energy system - How does hydrogen demand affect infrastructure needs?'
